hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Filter tweets in February 2024 and identify the trending tags mentioned across posts.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Extract text starting with # up to the next space or line boundary, then aggregate counts.

hints.title: Query Structure
hints.text: Use string extraction to isolate the hashtag, group by hashtag, and order by count descending then hashtag descending with limit 3.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT
    CONCAT('#', SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(tweet, '#', -1), ' ', 1)) AS hashtag,
    COUNT(*) AS hashtag_count
FROM Tweets
WHERE tweet_date BETWEEN '2024-02-01' AND '2024-02-29'
GROUP BY hashtag
ORDER BY hashtag_count DESC, hashtag DESC
LIMIT 3;
```

complexity.notes: Date filtering, string split, and top 3 aggregation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Omitting date filtering counts hashtags from other periods.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Filter on February 2024 and correctly parse hashtag token.

solutions.code:
SELECT
    CONCAT('#', SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(tweet, '#', -1), ' ', 1)) AS hashtag,
    COUNT(*) AS hashtag_count
FROM Tweets
WHERE tweet_date BETWEEN '2024-02-01' AND '2024-02-29'
GROUP BY hashtag
ORDER BY hashtag_count DESC, hashtag DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT
    SUBSTRING(tweet FROM '#[A-Za-z0-9_]+') AS hashtag,
    COUNT(*) AS hashtag_count
FROM Tweets
WHERE tweet_date BETWEEN '2024-02-01' AND '2024-02-29'
GROUP BY hashtag
ORDER BY hashtag_count DESC, hashtag DESC
LIMIT 3;
